probe.private_reasoning: Based on the negotiations and the previous drafts exchanged, it is likely that the other side had an initial bottom-line figure for the severance amount and non-compete duration. The progression from six months of severance to twelve months indicates their initial position was more favorable to the company. This likely suggests they are willing to negotiate upwards from their original proposal. However, the adjustment of the non-compete clause from twelve months to six months indicates a concession, possibly due to our feedback or pushback. Thus, their bottom line for severance is likely around twelve months, and the non-compete around six months reflects a more industry-standard duration that could be negotiable depending on further discussions.
